SOURCE/HISTORY: Contract 5340/2026, Oyoon 266 ANPR Data Management AMC, req.12600246; dated 22-Jul-2026. Parties: Digital Dubai Government Establishment (affiliated with Digital Dubai Authority) and VITRONIC MACHINE VISION MIDDLE EAST (L.L.C.). Term: 01-Jul-2026–30-Jun-2027 (pp1–3). Both signatures visible (p33): H.E. Matar AlHumairi, CEO DDGE, 29-Sep-2026 09:48 UTC+4; Dr Youssef El Hansali, CEO, date literally 03-08-2018. Vendor year is anomalous; retain and confirm. Signature authenticity not cryptographically validated. 29-Sep email supplied countersigned copy with LPO pending; current LPO/payment status unverified.
FEES/SECURITY: AED528,000 fixed, excluding VAT/applicable fees (p4). Four planned invoices AED132,000/25% each: 01-Oct-2026, 01-Jan-2027, 01-Apr-2027, 30-Jun-2027 (p34). Not payment evidence; no Net-days stated. BG: final/unconditional/irrevocable, local bank, 2% of contract value (AED10,560 derived), effective from start until 90 days after term end; revocation by DDGE consent, return after approved completion certificate (pp5,18). Audits/consultancy fees and ad-hoc/PSR limitations: see Coverage; rates unstated.
RENEWAL/DELIVERY: DDGE gives written intention-to-renew notice 30 days before expiry (p3); no automatic-renewal clause printed in this appendix. Amendments need mutual signed written addendum. Formal written DDGE acceptance required; rectify rejected/nonconforming service at no extra cost (pp2–4). Pre-approved qualified staff/replacements, progress meetings and complete records required (pp18–19).
PENALTIES: General sanctions/delay remedies refer to Law12/2020; no numeric daily rate or ARL deduction bands in this contract (pp4,22–23). Do not copy 5341 ARL rates. Clause12(9) states direct-loss indemnity, excludes indirect/consequential/lost profits save gross negligence/fraud/confidentiality breach, then compensation not exceeding100% of contract value (pp20–21); this is not an express SLA-credit cap. DDGE may set off amounts owed (p26). Exemptions for proven force majeure/customer cause require consent. Breach cure:30 working days after written notice; DDGE early termination:30 days written notice and payment for services rendered (pp16–17).
ESCALATION/NOTICES: L1 operational, L2 supervisory, L3 executive; P1 immediate L2 then L3 if unresolved; P2 L1 then escalate on SLA breach; P3/P4 L1 unless repeated/breached. Document in email/JIRA (pp30–32). DDGE L1 Huda Salim AlHashmi (hudasalim.alhashmi@digitaldubai.ae), L2 Shaikha Ibrahim Abdulla Almarzooqi (shaikha.almarzooqi@digitaldubai.ae), L3 Abdulla Ali Salem Bin Kenaid AlFalasi (abdulla.alfalasi@digitaldubai.ae). VITRONIC L1 Abdalrhman Asaad, L2 Laith Hamdan, L3 Dr Youssef El Hansali. Official notices: Huda and Mohammed Ahmed Abdo Al Omari (mohammad.alomari@vitronic.com), by personal delivery/registered mail/email; notify contact changes (pp29–32).
SECURITY/GOVERNANCE: Confidentiality survives; ISO27001/22301, ISR/DESC and applicable PCI DSS controls. Written actual/suspected cyber-incident notice within24h; report and cooperate (pp7–15). RCA separately due48h after resolution (p36). Cloud/AI need prior approval; UAE data residency unless approved; protect personal data, return/delete/certify and support secure exit. Subcontract/assignment need written consent; supplier remains liable. DDGE compliance audits at no extra cost. Force-majeure notice within7 working days. Dubai/UAE law; amicable dispute30 days then senior management/Dubai Courts. Main contract prevails over appendices; Arabic prevails (pp2,15–28). Full attached PDF governs.
main_fields.service_coverage:
SIGNED OPERATION & SLA APPENDIX, pp35–36.
PRODUCTS: Level A: Vitronic Intelligent Tracking System (VITIS) v3.48.1; Roadside Remote Management (RRM) v2.19.4; Smart Dashboard v2.1.0. Level B: Vitronic Intelligent Tracking System v1.4.4 and ANPRPool (Main ANPR Pool Service). Levels C/D: no specific products defined; limited or no support.
SCOPE: Secured remote diagnostics/support; on-site visits if remote support fails within agreed Turnaround Time (no numeric onsite attendance time printed); telephone/email/JIRA support; quarterly technical support including system administration, performance tuning, fault diagnosis/repair; continuous maintenance bug fixes at no extra cost; remote configuration support scheduled in advance. System audits on request subject to service fees; on-site fault-analysis/optimization/re-engineering consultancy subject to fees. Administration remote/on-site by prior negotiation. Tailored training in operation, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting and reporting. Application support/development via Professional Services Request (PSR). Pre-booked/ad-hoc services only on explicit request and outside agreement. No extra-service rates specified.
PRIORITIES: P1 Critical major system impact: response1h, workaround8h, MTTR24h, explicitly24/7. P2 Urgent partial impact/no workaround: response1h, workaround24h, MTTR48h. P3 Standard fault/no operational impact: resolution72h AND MTTR14days in same line; preserve both and clarify before treating one as sole deadline. P4 Enhancement/no operational impact: resolution by agreed timeline; no fixed numeric row. RCA all incidents within48h of resolution. Coverage hours for P2–P4, general support calendar, calendar/business basis and availability percentage are unspecified. Escalation clause calls P2 High; appendix calls it Urgent.
EXCLUSIONS: Dubai Police-supplied software except ANPR Pool Service; unauthorized hardware/software changes; system installation/relocation; consumables repair; faults not caused by normal usage.
LIMITS: No dedicated allocated engineer promise is printed here (do not copy 5341). No ARL/service-credit schedule appears. Optional supplier system audits are distinct from general clause16 compliance-audit assistance without extra cost. Underlying technical/financial offers QU040000261 Jul-26 appear only as references/icons (p34), not embedded offer content. Source PDF supplements these notes.

offset_right.text: First Party may offset/deduct from supplier payments sums, payments or claims owed under the contract or from supplier failure to perform.

general_sanctions.text: Failure to provide services/materials or exceeding the granted time limit permits legal action under Law 12 of 2020 and relevant UAE laws. Delay penalties/fines/measures are referred to that law; no numeric daily delay rate or service-credit cap is stated in these general clauses. An exemption for emergency, force majeure, First Party cause or other cause beyond supplier control requires supporting proof and First Party consent.

general_compensation_cap_and_liability.text: Supplier indemnifies direct damages/losses and related claims arising from breach. Wording excludes indirect losses, consequential damages and lost profits, save damages arising from gross negligence, fraud or confidentiality breach. It then states compensation shall not exceed 100% of total contract value. Preserve this clause wording; it is not an express cap on SLA deductions, and the treatment of exceptions is not resolved here. Supplier remains liable for third-party performance.

penalties.rule_note: Do not treat the general 100% compensation wording as an express SLA deduction cap.
